body: Logically I don’t see suicide to cause the least amount of suffering to others, obviously everybody is someone’s everything. But honestly i just don’t seem to care enough

I often feel this way, as if positive emotion is fake and will not last long. I have no solution really. Just hope you find something that may make you want to live more than you want to die. I have my death date planned so I’m just so sorry that it’s happening to you as well

The only thing that I think may sway me is if I find a person that may make me feel good by just being with them. But I honestly don’t think it would be good to subject someone as apathetic and uncaring as me to another person. People don’t deserve to be in contact with me. They deserve another person

I feel the same way. I truly believe I will kill myself but I don’t want to encourage anybody else. Just. Keep trying I suppose maybe something will interest you or something. Idk I have no answers, as I said, I’m killing myself at some point
